claim_boundary: Static schema and fixture consistency only. No research job, adjudication, packet delivery, budget denial or provenance check is executed; runtime, provider, recovery, security, visual and performance proof remains NOT_RUN.

value.title: Restore readiness consistency
value.proposition: A readiness receipt must not report ready for owner activation while a blocking workspace, colocation or working-copy field is set.

value.title: Creation-time object-format selection
value.proposition: A new repository may offer an evidence-gated object-format choice at creation time.

value.title: Restore-drill object verification has no defined depth
value.proposition: A completeness result is admissible whatever verification depth produced it, so a connectivity-only verifier would pass a corrupt-blob closure.

value.title: Adapter implementation shape
value.proposition: The proposal restates an obligation the owner document already carries.

value.plain_name: Choose the storage format when you create a repository
value.question: Should Puppet Master let you pick the repository storage format when you create a new one?
value.why_it_came_up: The research found that the format is fixed at creation and cannot be changed later, so the choice has to be offered there or not at all.
value.what_you_get: A choice at creation time, with the option disabled and explained whenever your installed tools cannot support it.
value.what_it_costs: Setup gains one more decision, and Puppet Master has to keep evidence of which tools support which format.
options: Add the picker as described, evidence-gated
Keep the current default format and offer no choice
value.recommendation: Add the picker as described, evidence-gated.

value.plain_name: Graph gestures as their own actions
value.question: Should graph gestures be their own set of actions rather than pictures of the existing ones?
value.why_it_came_up: The research found that the graph's gestures do not map onto the existing single-target actions.
value.what_you_get: Graph actions that say what they do, instead of a picture of a different action.
value.what_it_costs: A second action vocabulary to keep consistent with the first.
options: Give the graph its own action vocabulary
Keep the graph as a view over the existing actions
Defer until the graph view is built

invalid.name: job_admits_a_decision_record_input
invalid.reason: A recorded decision may never enter a research input, so a finding cannot be an echo of an answer the product already holds (ERS-003).

invalid.name: job_discovery_reads_the_frozen_snapshot
invalid.rejects_for: stage conditional forbidding frozen_plans_snapshot before reconcile
invalid.reason: The frozen plans snapshot enters no earlier than reconciliation; discovery and the studies see the brief and their own artifacts only (ERS-003).

invalid.name: job_claims_a_designed_stop_after_a_time_cut
invalid.reason: A job cut by its time limit did not reach a designed stop, and calling it one would hide a truncated result (ERS-002, ERS-009).

invalid.name: job_reports_an_adapter_label_as_its_bound
invalid.reason: An adapter may report any denial as a budget denial when the cause was the response ceiling, so an adapter label is not an admissible source (ERS-009).

invalid.name: job_without_a_run_manifest
invalid.reason: A job that names no run manifest cannot be reproduced from its own records (ERS-014).

invalid.name: job_with_an_unhashed_input
invalid.reason: Every admitted input is recorded by path and SHA-256, and a job whose inputs do not hash to the recorded values fails closed before dispatch (ERS-003).

invalid.name: finding_correction_routed_to_a_user_decision
invalid.reason: A correction to an existing promise lands under the standing repair authorization; routing it to the user would ask the user to approve a repair (ERS-006).

invalid.name: finding_capability_landed_under_repair_authorization
invalid.reason: A capability is not a repair; landing one under the repair authorization would add product scope the user never approved (ERS-007).

invalid.name: finding_credited_without_a_cited_passage
invalid.reason: A credit requires a delivered assertion stating the same proposition with the passage it cites; without one the judgement cannot be re-checked (ERS-004, ERS-013).

invalid.name: finding_candidate_declared_inside_the_union
invalid.reason: Adding a candidate to the union is the union owner's act, never the adjudicator's (ERS-004).

invalid.name: finding_candidate_without_a_rejection_check
invalid.rejects_for: credit_state candidate requires a non-empty rejection_check_refs
invalid.reason: An out-of-union candidate is recorded with an explicit check against the expansions the union already rejected (ERS-004).

invalid.name: finding_credited_to_no_job
invalid.rejects_for: credit_state credited requires a non-null credited_job_ref
invalid.reason: A credit names the job whose delivered assertion earned it, so the receipt per credit is not optional (ERS-013).

invalid.name: finding_with_an_invented_class
invalid.reason: Every finding carries exactly one of the four classes; a fifth class would let a finding escape both landing paths (ERS-004).

invalid.name: packet_presented_all_at_once
invalid.reason: Items are presented one at a time; presenting the whole packet as the decision surface is the form DL-036 replaced (ERS-005).

invalid.name: packet_using_colored_status_bars
invalid.reason: Status and disposition use text labels; no colored border bars or stripes and no emoji glyphs (DL-036, ERS-005).

invalid.name: packet_without_its_artifact
invalid.reason: The full artifact containing every item must exist before any item is presented and stay openable throughout (DL-036, ERS-005).

invalid.name: card_built_from_a_correction_finding
invalid.rejects_for: card finding_class limited to capability and product_choice
invalid.reason: A correction lands under the standing repair authorization and never becomes a decision card (ERS-005, ERS-006).

invalid.name: card_with_a_fifth_response
invalid.reason: The DL-036 response set is fixed at four; an added response such as auto-approval is exactly what the decision flow forbids (ERS-005).

invalid.name: card_with_reordered_responses
invalid.reason: The four responses are fixed in order, so a card cannot re-present them in a different order (ERS-005).

invalid.name: card_answered_without_a_recorded_time
invalid.reason: A disposition is recorded so the same question is not asked again; an answer with no recorded time is not a disposition (ERS-005, ERS-007).

invalid.name: card_offering_a_single_option
invalid.reason: A decision card presents the options; one option is not a decision (ERS-005).

options: Add the picker as described, evidence-gated

invalid.name: receipt_averaging_after_one_reconciled_job
invalid.rejects_for: same_arm_same_stage_average requires reconciled_jobs_for_average of at least 2
invalid.reason: A stage allowance switches from the cold allowance to the observed average only after two fully reconciled same-arm same-stage jobs (ERS-008).

invalid.name: receipt_dropping_the_unresolved_charge
invalid.rejects_for: native_records_present false requires a positive unresolved_usage_usd
invalid.reason: A terminal job with no complete native accounting retains its allowance as a separate unresolved charge that counts against the cap indefinitely (ERS-008).

invalid.name: receipt_presented_as_a_billed_amount
invalid.reason: Captured usage is an upper-bound estimate, never a billed amount or a certified total liability (ERS-008).

patch.estimate_disclaimer: final billed amount for this research topic

invalid.name: receipt_without_a_lifetime_cap
invalid.reason: Admission is checked against the arm's lifetime cap, so a receipt that names no cap proves no admission (ERS-008, ERS-009).

invalid.name: manifest_with_a_declared_runtime_version
invalid.reason: Declared runtime versions went stale when the runtime was updated in place at the same path; identity is read from the installed binary at capability time (ERS-014).

invalid.name: manifest_hashed_with_live_telemetry
invalid.reason: A monitor heartbeat written after the freeze makes an otherwise identical tree fail re-hashing, so telemetry is quiesced before hashing (ERS-014).

invalid.name: manifest_whose_freeze_followed_its_first_job
invalid.reason: A provenance file exists to show that the code preceded the run; a freeze recorded after the jobs it governed asserts the opposite (ERS-014).

invalid.name: manifest_without_protocol_file_hashes
invalid.reason: Two runs share a fingerprint only if each pins the protocol file hashes it validated against (ERS-014).

invalid.name: manifest_with_a_malformed_freeze_timestamp
invalid.reason: A malformed freeze timestamp is the one field a reader checks in a provenance file, and it was a real published defect in the continuation-4 bundle (ERS-014).
